Nina and Amy are in the same class. We talk about history a lot. Nina's favorite season is autumn. In fact, my brother goes to college in Shanghai.
My friend Amy is very kind. Nina usually eats rice for lunch. We often go to the cinema together. The canteen serves noodles till two.
The school garden is not far from my home. I like my life very much. Amy often helps me with history.
